dedupe_keys.name: cfti5med the new release of the catalogue of strong earthquakes in italy and in the mediterranean area

description: CFTI5Med, the new release of the catalogue of strong earthquakes in Italy and in the Mediterranean area is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Emanuela Guidoboni et al. A key element for assessing seismic hazard and risk is the availability of a dataset on past earthquakes. Here we present the rationale, structure and contents of CFTI5Med ( https://doi.org/10.6092/ingv.it-cfti5 ), the 2018 version of the Catalogue of Strong Earthquakes in Italy: a large multidisciplinary effort including historians, seismologists and geologists. Coverage: national (IT); published in 2019. Formats: ZIP, CSV, TXT, XML, KML. The data are held in PANGAEA and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 3 datasets. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
